evals.name: new-project-research
evals.prompt: I'm kicking off a new piece of work to build a realtime document collaboration feature. Before I forget, save this research finding: I compared Yjs and Automerge for CRDT sync — Yjs is faster and has a much bigger ecosystem, while Automerge has nicer built-in version-control APIs. Tag it crdt, realtime, collaboration.
evals.expected_output: Resolves/creates a project (asks or suggests a name), then saves a research note under projects/<YYYY_MM_DD_slug>/researches/YYYY_MM_DD_<slug>.md with type:research, the three tags, and the content. Indexes updated.

evals.name: write-specs
evals.prompt: Set up a project called 'billing-system' and write its specs. The technical spec: a modular monolith on PostgreSQL, Stripe for payment processing, webhook-driven entitlement updates. The solution spec (non-technical): describe the capabilities — subscription signup, plan upgrades/downgrades, invoicing, and dunning for failed payments.
evals.expected_output: Creates project 2026_..._billing-system, writes specs/technical.md and specs/solution.md with the right content and spec_type frontmatter. specs/index.md lists both.

evals.name: sprint-story-task-tracking
evals.prompt: For my checkout project, set up sprint 1 with the goal 'MVP checkout'. Add a user story US-1 'Checkout flow' described as 'As a user I can pay with a card'. Under it, create two tasks: 'Build payment form' and 'Add card validation'. Mark the payment form task as in progress.
evals.expected_output: Creates a project, sprints/sprint-1 (goal set), us-001 with description, two task files us-001-task-001/002, first task status in-progress. Indexes roll up the statuses.

evals.name: organize-and-find
evals.prompt: Inside a project for our mobile app, save two research notes — one titled 'Push Notification Providers' (compared FCM vs OneSignal vs APNs direct) tagged 'mobile,notifications', and one titled 'Offline Sync Strategies' (last-write-wins vs CRDT) tagged 'mobile,sync'. Then show me everything that's in the project so far.
evals.expected_output: Creates one project, writes two research notes with correct tags, then lists/searches and presents the project index showing both notes.
